deleteProfile.title: Move to Trash
deleteProfile.confirmAfter: to Trash? You can restore it later unless you also wipe its data.
deleteProfile.noData: No local browser data on disk yet.
deleteProfile.alsoDeleteHint: Permanently wipes the data dir on disk. The profile can still be restored, but it will start logged-out and empty.
deleteProfile.irreversible: This part is irreversible: logins and cookies will be gone.

activity.title: Activity Log
activity.empty: No recorded activity yet. Launch this profile to start tracking.

leakCheck.title: Leak Check Analysis
leakCheck.trustScoreFrom: Trust score from {{pass}} pass · {{warn}} warn · {{fail}} fail.
leakCheck.liveTestHint: Reads the real navigator, timezone and WebRTC values from the profile's open browser. The profile must be running.

details.ipNoProxy: No profile proxy in use, so sites see this computer's real IP.
details.webrtcFirefox: WebRTC is off in Firefox profiles, so it cannot show the real IP.
details.webrtcRealProxy: Set to Real: WebRTC can show the real IP behind the proxy.
details.webrtcRealNoProxy: Set to Real with no proxy: sites already see this computer's IP, so WebRTC shows them nothing new.
details.webrtcMode: Mode {{mode}}: WebRTC does not show the real IP.
details.tzNoProxy: Based on IP, but no proxy is set.
details.tzHost: Uses this computer's timezone, which may not match the proxy location.
details.tzCustomMismatch: Custom {{timezone}} does not match the proxy's {{proxyTimezone}}.
details.tzCustomUnknown: Custom {{timezone}}: could not compare it with the proxy.
details.tzUnsetUnknown: Custom, but no timezone is set: could not compare it with the proxy.
details.langAutoProxy: Set automatically from the proxy's country.
details.langMismatch: Language region {{region}} does not match the proxy's country {{country}}.
details.langCustomUnknown: Custom ({{language}}): could not compare it with the proxy.
details.langUnsetUnknown: Custom, but no language is set: could not compare it with the proxy.
details.geoCustom: Custom ({{lat}}, {{lng}}): check that it matches the proxy region.
details.fpOn: Canvas, WebGL and audio noise are on.
details.fpOff: One or more fingerprint noise settings are off.
details.liveIpUnknown: Could not read the exit IP from the page.
details.liveWebrtcLeak: WebRTC shows a public IP that differs from the exit IP: {{ips}}
details.liveWebrtcOk: Addresses: {{ips}}. No public IP differs from the exit IP.
details.liveTzMatch: Browser timezone {{timezone}} matches the exit IP.
details.liveTzMismatch: Browser timezone {{timezone}} does not match the exit IP's {{exitTimezone}}.
details.liveTzUnknown: Browser timezone {{timezone}}; the exit IP's timezone is unknown.

device.noRenderer: No WebGL renderer is set, so the graphics card was not checked.
device.macD3d: A macOS profile reports a Direct3D (Windows only) graphics card, which shows the real system. Set WebGL to Custom with an Apple (Metal) renderer, or use this computer's system.
device.linuxD3d: A Linux profile reports a Direct3D (Windows only) graphics card, which shows the real system. Use a Mesa (OpenGL) renderer, or this computer's system.
device.windowsMetal: A Windows profile reports a Metal (Apple only) graphics card, a clear mismatch.
device.windowsMesa: A Windows profile reports a Mesa (Linux only) graphics card, a clear mismatch.
device.mobileD3d: A mobile profile reports a Direct3D (Windows desktop) graphics card, a clear mismatch.
device.mobileOk: A mobile profile reports a mobile graphics card.
device.mobileDesktopGpu: A mobile profile reports a desktop graphics card, a clear mismatch.
device.desktopMobileGpu: A desktop profile reports a mobile graphics card, a clear mismatch.
device.desktopOk: The graphics card fits this desktop system.
